mapper.insert: insert ignore into official_broadcast_log (broadcast_id, member_id, role, channel, reached, clicked, create_time) values (#{broadcastId}, #{memberId}, #{role}, #{channel}, #{reached}0, 0, now())
mapper.select: select count(1) from official_broadcast_log where broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} and channel='inapp' and delivery_state='INAPP_STORED'
select count(1) from official_broadcast_log where broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} and channel='inapp' and clicked = 1
select count(1) from official_broadcast_log where member_id = #{memberId} and channel = 'inapp' and reached = 1 and create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
mapper.update: update official_broadcast_log set clicked = 1 where broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} and member_id = #{memberId} and channel = #{channel}
update official_broadcast_log set reached = 1 where broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} and member_id = #{memberId} and channel = #{channel}
mapper.select: select id,member_id,role,channel,delivery_state,frozen_title,frozen_sub,intent_id,message_id,attempts from official_broadcast_log where broadcast_id=#{broadcastId} order by id
select * from official_broadcast_log where id=#{id} for update
mapper.update: update official_broadcast_log set delivery_state=#{state},intent_id=#{intent},message_id=#{message},attempts=attempts+#{attempt},update_time=now(3),reached=case when #{state}='INAPP_STORED' then 1 else 0 end where id=#{id}
